description: Connects a YouTube channel through Google OAuth. Without `channelId` returns the consent URL for the user to open (valid for about 10 minutes), `channels` (authorized, with no destination yet: pass one's `channelId` to create it) and `connected` (channels that already are destinations); with `channelId` creates the destination.

name.description: With channelId only. Omitted: the channel title.

name: destination_create_youtube_oauth
title: Connect a YouTube channel
